answer: Stake bonds: each validator locks 10,000 tokens to register. Slashing burns collateral on proven duplicate identity. The karst of overlapping accounts erodes fast when detection costs 1 report but forfeits 10k. A beacon of randomness assigns audit quorums, so a farm of n ids faces n×10k cost versus linear rewards. On the tundra of zero-reputation wallets, this barrier alone blocks mass registration. Works because sybil cost scales linearly while honest stake stays fixed.
